findings.text: the replaced index's journal sidecars are discarded inline in cli.py, while index_placement owns index-file lifecycle and installs a database into the same directory by os.replace at index_placement.py:264 with no journal handling, so a second caller that installs an index inherits the stale-journal hazard this node repaired with nothing in the owning module to reuse.

monkeypatch.setattr(cli.os, "replace", check_swap) patches the process-global os module attribute rather than a cli-local seam, so the interceptor also sees unrelated os.replace calls made through the same module object, including index_placement's restore.
